context: A boss invites his manager to a business dinner reservation
purpose: Teach: 鶏/調理/放題/代金/飲食/定員/ピーク/支払う

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今度の金曜、銀座の飲食店で部署の会食を予約したよ。
lines.en: I booked a department dinner at a restaurant in Ginza this Friday.
lines.style: warm authoritative boss tone inviting his subordinate

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。どんなお店ですか?
lines.en: Thank you. What kind of place is it?
lines.style: polite curious office worker showing respect

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 鶏料理の専門店でね、調理が丁寧だと評判なんだ。
lines.en: It's a chicken specialty restaurant, famous for careful cooking.
lines.style: informative boss describing restaurant with quiet pride

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: へえ、食べ放題のコースもあるんでしょうか?
lines.en: Oh, do they have an all-you-can-eat course too?
lines.style: casual interested employee asking light follow-up question

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: あるよ。ただ金曜の夜はピーク時で、定員もすぐ埋まるらしい。
lines.en: They do. But Friday nights peak fast and seats fill quickly.
lines.style: experienced boss sharing practical scheduling concern calmly

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど。代金はどうしましょうか、各自で支払う形ですか?
lines.en: I see. How about the bill, does each person pay separately?
lines.style: considerate employee clarifying payment details politely

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回は私が出すから、気にせず楽しんでくれ。
lines.en: I'll cover it this time, so just relax and enjoy yourself.
lines.style: generous boss reassuring his subordinate with warmth

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 恐縮です。皆も喜びますよ、楽しみにしています。
lines.en: I'm honored. Everyone will be pleased, I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: grateful employee accepting graciously with sincere appreciation
